channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jeanie Buss | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jeanie Buss from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Byron Scott on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
Byron Scott:

“Listen, it matters but it don't matter because we got no say so whatsoever. You know what I'm saying? But it matters because of the fact that when you play for the Lakers, like we have, and it's under the Buss family, that umbrella, you just never thought or never imagined it ever being owned by somebody else. So, I'm sure just like all three of us, the first sale to the Walters Group for 10 billion, we all were like, 'What?' They sold? And then my second thought was, 'Oh shit, 10 billion, okay, well I get it.' You know what I'm saying? But you still have that initial shock of them being sold because you just never fathomed the fact that the Buss family would not own the Lakers.”

Byron Scott on Jeanie Buss, Sep 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Bob Iger on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
“And we have every intention to honor the agreement that was made between Mark and Jeanie. If things change, they’ll change, but we’re going into this with enormous respect and appreciation for who she is and what she represents in the organization.”

Bob Iger on Jeanie Buss, Aug 12, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Bob Iger on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
Statement to ESPN from Josh Kushner and Bob Iger:

“As lifelong NBA fans, we are deeply honored for the opportunity to become stewards of the Los Angeles Lakers, one of the most iconic sports franchises in the world. We have immense respect for the leadership and vision of Jerry and Jeanie Buss. Our long-term commitment is to build on that foundation, compete at the highest level, and serve this extraordinary team, its fans, and the city of Los Angeles.”

Bob Iger on Jeanie Buss, Aug 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bob Iger on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
Iger told the Post he and Kushner intend to honor the agreement made between Walter and Buss.

“We have enormous respect and appreciation for Jeanie, her father and what they’ve contributed to this franchise,”

Bob Iger on Jeanie Buss, Aug 12, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mark Walter on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
Statement to ESPN fromMark Walter:

“Owning the Los Angeles Lakers has been one of the great honors of my life - an extraordinary investment, but what I will carry with me is the community, the fans, and a city that treats this team as family. I am grateful to Jeanie Buss, the Buss family, the players, and the staff for welcoming me into this chapter. The Lakers belong to Los Angeles, and I have every confidence the best is still ahead.”

Mark Walter on Jeanie Buss, Aug 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Jeanie Buss, Mark Walter
item.description:
Rob Pelinka on whether Mark Walter’s resources are starting to be put into the Lakers:

“Jeanie and I did a really deep dive with him on sort of the areas he wants to grow.... There will be some positive changes and we will build things out”

Rob Pelinka on Jeanie Buss, Mark Walter, Feb 7, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
“I expressed that. Like, it was, ‘Y’all gave me an opportunity. Rob, you gave me an opportunity. Jeanie, you’ve treated my family amazing. Everything we’ve wanted, needed since we’ve been here, you’ve taken care of. And we appreciate y’all of that,’”

Austin Reaves on Jeanie Buss, Sep 30, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
“Because Jeanie’s the one who has elevated him every step of the way … I don’t anticipate, certainly not in the short-term, the way the Lakers operate changing dramatically whatsoever.”

Rob Pelinka on Jeanie Buss, Aug 3, 2025. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: Rich Paul on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
“He knows the Lakers are building for the future. He understands that, but he values a realistic chance of winning it all. We are very appreciative of the partnership that we've had for eight years with Jeanie [Buss] and Rob [Pelinka] and consider the Lakers as a critical part of his career.”

Rich Paul on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka, Jun 29, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
“So, to get to this place, there are a couple of people I want to thank. First and foremost is Jeanie Buss. She’s so supportive,”

Rob Pelinka on Jeanie Buss, Feb 11, 2025. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Pat Riley on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
Pat Riley statement on his future statue in Los Angeles:

“One of my first messages to the team was ‘The journey of a thousand miles starts with our first step. Where it takes you, is up to us.’ And it took us to five championships in the 80’s with the Showtime Lakers. It was a hell of a journey and the fact that it’s ending up with the arrival of a statue is mind blowing to me. I’d like to thank Jeanie and the entire Buss family for this honor.”

Pat Riley on Jeanie Buss, Nov 20, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
While Ham has issues to resolve both in his locker room and elsewhere within Laker Land, he has the continued support of owner Jeanie Buss.

“I told you, man, I’m just thankful that I’ve got that support from Jeanie, with her always encouraging me, asking me ‘What do I need? Is everything great?’”

Darvin Ham on Jeanie Buss, Jan 8, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Darvin Ham, Jeanie Buss, Anthony Davis
item.description:
“Jeanie [Buss] and Darvin [Ham] and I were just probably the most excited to just get Anthony's perspective on what it means to do an extension like this and what it means to become a leader of the Lakers for years to come,”

Rob Pelinka on Darvin Ham, Jeanie Buss, Anthony Davis, Aug 9, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
LAKERS |Jersey retirement ceremony Pau Gasol on RAC1:

“The ceremony could be the next season. Yes, I've talked to the franchise and Buss familiy. We are all very excited”

Pau Gasol on Jeanie Buss, Jul 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarcMundet78.

item.title: Anthony Davis on LeBron James, Jeanie Buss, Rich Paul, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Paul, who also represents the Lakers’ Anthony Davis, told The Athletic.

“And I don’t think that’s who we are, who LeBron is. We have a great partnership with the Lakers. The Klutch Sports Group and the Lakers don’t have an issue. Rich Paul and Rob Pelinka don’t have an issue. LeBronJames and Rob Pelinka don’t have an issue. And Jeanie Buss and LeBron and Rich Paul don’t have an issue. It’s very simple. Very simple. So, you know, whoever put that type of stuff out, and people run with it, I think it’s unfair to the Lakers.”

Anthony Davis on LeBron James, Jeanie Buss, Rich Paul, Rob Pelinka, Feb 26, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka, Linda Rambis
item.description:
Anthony Davis:

“I just wanted to take the process one day at a time. Obviously winning the championship with L.A. was very great. The team Rob (Pelinka) put together, and Jeanie (Buss) put together, and Linda (Rambis) and all the people in the front office was amazing, and we did something special. Especially with everything going on in 2020.I don’t think there was a doubt that I was gonna come back, it was just trying to figure out the logistics and what was best for me and my family, and I was able to get a deal done today.”

Anthony Davis on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka, Linda Rambis, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Silverscreenandroll.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
LeBron:

“My relationship with @Jeanie Buss I would say is incredible. I think she’s an unbelievable owner, a powerful woman. I think what she believes in is an extension of her father, and continuing to build this legacy of this great franchise. I’m just happy to be a part of it.”

LeBron James on Jeanie Buss, Oct 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
“I don't think Magic could afford them. And that's no disrespect to Magic. That's a reflection of just how well Jeanie has done.”

Mark Cuban on Jeanie Buss, Jun 5, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
Magic Johnson on @SportsCenter:

“I've never sat in an HR person's office in 35 years. Two years w/ the #Lakers, no HR appearance. Do you think Jeanie Buss would allow me to abuse the employees? If that was the case, she would've called me in.”

Magic Johnson on Jeanie Buss, May 28, 2019. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Rob Pelinka on the front office:

“When it comes to a basketball decision, I collaborate with the staff, and I make a recommendation to Jeanie (Buss) and she blesses that or not.”

Rob Pelinka on Jeanie Buss, May 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Luke Walton on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
“I want to thank Jeanie Buss and the Buss family for giving me the opportunity to coach the Lakers,”

Luke Walton on Jeanie Buss, Apr 12, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Wade said of the gesture.

“I wanted to thank Rob Pelinka, Magic, Jeanie Buss. Just the whole Laker front office and Laker Nation for allowing that to happen. I did not expect that. That was so cool. I looked over and saw my wife beaming. It was great. I appreciate them for giving me that moment.”

Dwyane Wade on Jeanie Buss, Rob Pelinka, Dec 11, 2018. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
“At some point, the mother of dragons just has to accept the fact that she has three big-ass dragons. Jeanie has always been reluctant to take the reins. I think she was very concerned or conscious about respecting her father’s wishes, of how responsibility of the team management would divvy up, and I could tell it had always been something that was kind of hamstringing her a little bit.”

Kobe Bryant on Jeanie Buss, Oct 14, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
“Jeanie, I know who we’re trying to get; we know who we’re trying to get, so that player is not going to come here with all of this shit going on. It’s not going to happen,”

Kobe Bryant on Jeanie Buss, Oct 11, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
Lakers GM Rob Pelinka said team management supported second-year coach Luke Walton.

“Luke’s done a tremendous job. We fully support him — Magic, myself, Jeanie,”

Rob Pelinka on Jeanie Buss, Jan 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @Mike_Bresnahan.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
“It’s under my watch. I apologize to Jeanie, and that was the main thing. I told her she could take it out of my salary because I don’t want the Lakers to be paying that fine.… I don’t want her spending $500,000, because she didn’t do anything. That’s on me.”

Magic Johnson on Jeanie Buss, Sep 5, 2017. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Johnny Buss on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
He says he and his brother were aiming for a majority on the board to get control of the budget, but insists he did not know about the effort to elect a board without Jeanie.

“I immediately apologized to Jeanie saying, ‘Hey, look. This is not what I wanted. Please don’t include me in this,’”

Johnny Buss on Jeanie Buss, Jun 18, 2017. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Johnny Buss on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
“Jeanie did not accept my apology. Decided to publicly string me up and you know, it was sad.”

Johnny Buss on Jeanie Buss, Jun 18, 2017. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Johnny Buss on Jeanie Buss, Jim Buss
item.description:
Ramona Shelburne:Robert Sacks, lawyer for Jim and Johnny Buss:

“Both Jim and Johnny hoped that any issues that might arise would be handled w/in the family. We informed her lawyers orally and in writing that Jim and Johnny fully support Jeanie as the controlling owner of the Lakers. Then inexplicably she then rushed into court saying they’re trying to oust me as the controlling owner. I can tell you, Jim Buss and Johnny Buss, as co-trustees, who vote shares in the Lakers, support Jeanie as the controlling owner. Yesterday both Jim & Johnny Buss signed a formal corporate document that voted trust shares to re-elect Jeanie as controlling owner.”

Johnny Buss on Jeanie Buss, Jim Buss, Mar 3, 2017. Source: Twitter @ramonashelburne.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Jeanie Buss
item.description:
More from Magic Johnson on First Take:

“I can’t step in between Jim and Jeanie. That’s their thing. Jeanie’s gotta handle that.”

Magic Johnson on Jeanie Buss, Feb 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @taniaganguli.
